Exercise: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up (Squat style)

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- compound

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- abdominals
- calves
- hamstrings
- quadriceps
- triceps

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- hypertrophy
- core_stability
- strength

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Lower back pain or injury

Exercise Variations:

- name: Turkish Get-Up with Single Arm Kettlebell, equipment: kettlebells
- name: Turkish Get-Up with Medicine Ball, equipment: medicine ball

Substitution Options:

- name: Dumbbell Turkish Get-Up (Squat style), equipment: dumbbells
- name: Kettlebell Renegade Row, equipment: kettlebells

Instructions:

- Lie on your back on the floor and press a kettlebell to the top position by extending the elbow. Bend the knee on the same side as the kettlebell.
- Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, pivot to the opposite side and use your non- working arm to assist you in driving forward to the lunge position.
- Using your free hand, push yourself to a seated position, then progressing to your feet. While looking up at the kettlebell, slowly stand up. Reverse the motion back to the starting position and repeat.
